observation: Front, top and iso inspected. One tile 33.50 mm square carrying a smooth circular landing pad sunk into a ring of scattered flat-topped boulders. The top view shows the pad as a clean circle with the rubble confined to the perimeter and none of it encroaching on the disc a piece stands on; the front view shows the boulders standing proud of the slab with irregular heights and no spire; the iso shows the rubble as discrete disjoint rocks rather than a fused mat. No misplaced, missing or extra geometry and no visible intersections. Untouched by this revision and byte-identical to the published set's. (The round was re-run after a measurement script's baseline path changed; the rendered views are byte-identical to the ones inspected in the previous round and this is the same inspection recorded against the current source.)
